title: Constructed-real max respects CReal.Equiv in both arguments
statement: For constructed reals x0, x1, x2, x3: if x0 is CReal.Equiv-equivalent to x1 and x2 is CReal.Equiv-equivalent to x3, then max(x0, x2) is CReal.Equiv-equivalent to max(x1, x3).

formal.statement: theorem CReal.max_congr : ((x0 : CReal) -> ((x1 : CReal) -> ((x2 : CReal) -> ((x3 : CReal) -> ((x4 : CReal.Equiv x0 x1) -> ((x5 : CReal.Equiv x2 x3) -> CReal.Equiv (CReal.max x0 x2) (CReal.max x1 x3)))))))

evidence.supports: CReal.max_congr is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
evidence.checker_command: cargo run -q --release -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example theorem_dependency_inventory -- CReal.max_congr 2>/dev/null | grep -cE '^CReal\.max_congr[[:space:]]'
